title: Number 1 — One God
memory_verse: "The LORD our God, the LORD is one." — Deuteronomy 6:4 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn the number 1 and understand that there is only one true God.
content: Today we are learning about the number 1! Hold up one finger. Can you count it? One!
The Bible teaches us something very special about the number 1. There is only ONE God! He made everything — the sky, the trees, the animals, and you!
Our one God is so big and so powerful that He does not need any help. He loves you very much, and there is no one else like Him.
activity: Hold up 1 finger. Find 1 object in the room. Draw a big number 1 and draw a picture of God's creation around it — maybe one sun, one tree, or one flower.
discussion: Can you hold up one finger?
What is one thing God made that you love?
